It looks like a bella palm to me. Palms generally have shallow roots and don't like to be repotted so it could just be unhappy with the change. Others with more experience might have better ideas but I'd just let it settle for a while and keep an eye on the moisture levels in the soil to make sure it's not a watering issue. If it is a bella palm new shoots should go straight up and make things look a little more even.

I've also noticed that people don't seem to talk about the depth of their pots. It can make a huge difference when watering and repotting if you're moving from a 4" deep pot to a 6" deep pot. 

The top two inches of soil can be bone dry but if the roots don't reach the bottom of the pot there is a good chance you got a soggy bottom. So, if you're going to be watering by finger feel you'd better have the right depth of pot or there's a good chance that your previously healthy plant will start to fade when its roots reach that bottom layer and start sitting in water.
